---
title: "Boxplots and violins"
description: "Two views of the same grouped distribution — a boxplot and a violin, side by side."
categories: [Statistical]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

`mark_boxplot()` and `mark_violin()` both summarise a continuous variable across
a discrete group. Here they are composed into a single figure with `hconcat()`.

```{r}
peng <- na.omit(datasets::penguins)

box <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_boxplot(x = species, y = flipper_len, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Boxplot", y = "flipper (mm)")

vio <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_violin(x = species, y = flipper_len, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Violin", y = NULL)

p <- hconcat(box, vio)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "boxplot-violin")
```
